description: This file defines extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure and add FaultInjectionGrainStorage as a storage provider in Orleans hosting. It provides methods to add fault injection memory storage with configurable options, mainly used for testing fault scenarios in Orleans silos.

classes.name: FaultInjectionStorageServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for configuring FaultInjectionGrainStorage in the service collection.

methods.name: AddFaultInjectionMemoryStorage
methods.description: Adds FaultInjectionGrainStorage as a memory storage provider to the service collection with customizable options and fault injection options.
